name: Cinematic Poster
description: Epic key art: a single dramatic focal image with cinematic lighting and colour grading, strong silhouette, atmospheric depth and a well-structured title treatment with tagline and billing block.
visual_characteristics: one iconic image; wide dramatic composition or heroic low-angle silhouette
colour-graded palette (teal/orange, monochrome red, cold blue) with a lit focal point
atmosphere: haze, light rays, particles, lens flares, vignette
professional typography: large title, tagline, credit block with condensed type

palette.guidance: Pick ONE grading: teal & orange (complementary), monochrome + one accent, or night-blue with warm key. Keep shadows deep and highlights controlled; keep saturated colour only around the light source.

geometry: Strong vertical or wide-cinematic silhouette shapes; leading lines to the focal point; foreground silhouettes framing the scene; central or golden-ratio anchor.
stroke: Little to none for art; type gets thin keylines; hairline rules in the billing block.
texture: Film grain (single feTurbulence overlay), subtle dust/particles, bloom around lights, soft vignette.
composition: Poster (2:3): top tagline, hero image dominating the middle, title lower third (large, wide tracking), billing block small at the bottom; strong value structure; depth planes with atmosphere.
typography: Title in bold cinematic serif/sans, wide tracking or heavily condensed; tagline small caps; billing block in condensed sans at 3-4% height; use paths for the title if possible.
lighting_depth: Volumetric: light rays as gradient polygons; rim light on silhouette; atmospheric perspective via layered haze; lens flare group at the light source.
svg_techniques: sky/backdrop with 3-4 stop linearGradient (grading); radialGradient for light bloom
light shafts: polygons with linearGradient opacity fade, low fill-opacity
silhouette layers in near-black with subtle rim strokes in light colour
grain overlay + vignette overlay as last two layers
avoid: real actor names / real film titles or logos

name: Fantasy
description: Storied worlds of castles, dragons, magic and ancient landscapes: painterly depth, glowing magic light, grand scale and richly layered atmosphere.
visual_characteristics: grand vistas with layered atmospheric depth (mist, mountains, ruins)
magical light sources (runes, orbs, dragon-fire, aurora) casting coloured glow
ornate detail: filigree, armour engraving, runic borders
heroic scale: tiny figures against monumental structures

palette.guidance: Rich jewel or earthy palettes with a magical accent (arcane teal/violet, ember orange). Atmospheric perspective: far layers desaturated toward sky colour. Sunset golds for heroic, cool twilight for mystery.

geometry: Organic terrain curves against strong architectural verticals (towers, spires); dragons and creatures with sweeping S-curve silhouettes; asymmetrical but weighted layout; ornate frames.
stroke: Painterly/mostly fills; optional fine dark outline (1-1.5) on key characters; rune strokes glowing (round caps).
texture: Soft mist layers, star/particle fields, subtle stone/bark textures via patterns; optional grain.
composition: Depth stack: foreground framing (rocks/trees), mid-ground hero, background castle/mountains with haze; light source off-centre creating a path of light; leading lines toward the focal point.
typography: Decorative serif or blackletter-like display for titles; runic glyphs as shapes; minimal.
lighting_depth: Motivated glow: radial gradients around magic; god rays; rim light on silhouettes; aerial perspective bands of low-opacity gradient.
svg_techniques: mountain ranges as layered paths with progressively lighter gradients and mist gradient bands between
glow via radialGradient (preferred) and one blur filter for hero magic only
stars/particles from a single <pattern> or <use> scatter
runes/ornaments as reusable <symbol>s

name: Sci-Fi
description: Futurist scenes of space, technology and alien worlds: clean engineered hard-surface forms, glowing instrument lights, vast scale and atmospheric nebulae or planetary vistas.
visual_characteristics: hard-surface engineered forms with panel lines, vents, greebles in moderation
vast scale: planets, rings, stations dwarfing ships
glowing indicator lights and engine plumes; lens flares off stars
cool palette with a warm sun/engine counter-light

palette.guidance: Deep space blue-black base; cool grey hulls with warm-lit edges; engine/energy accents (cyan, orange, magenta); planet atmospheres in teal/amber. Keep the brightest value at one focal light.

geometry: Modular hard-surface: bevelled shapes, straight panel seams, symmetrical hulls with asymmetric details; large circles for planets; orbits and trajectories as thin curves.
stroke: Fine 0.5-1 panel lines in darker hull tone; thin light rim strokes on lit edges; glow strokes on engines.
texture: Starfield (random small circles at varying opacities, or a <pattern>), subtle nebula clouds via layered gradients, panel line patterns.
composition: Cinematic diagonal: ship or station in the foreground at an angle, planet or star large behind; strong scale contrast; a single light source direction; empty space for scale.
typography: Clean sans or techno-condensed HUD text as small callouts (optional); vector mission patch style if requested.
lighting_depth: Hard single light (sun) plus soft bounce from the planet; rim light on hulls; atmospheric glow on the planet limb (radial gradient); engine glow with small blur.
svg_techniques: planet: circle with radialGradient shading + clipped cloud bands + limb-atmosphere ring (radialGradient stroke)
hull shapes as layered polygons with linearGradient for metal; panel lines as thin paths
starfield: 80-200 <circle>s generated by script or one <pattern> tile scaled; vary radius and opacity
glow through a single small filter on engine group

name: Horror
description: Dread through restraint: deep shadows, sickly colour, distorted proportions, obscured details and a single unsettling focal point revealed by hard, unnatural light.
visual_characteristics: dominant darkness (70%+ of the canvas) with a small area of hard cold or sickly light
distortion: elongated limbs, uneven eyes, off-balance framing
fog, vignette, and silhouettes hiding detail; reveal only the eyes/hands/shape
muted sickly palette with one visceral accent (blood red or toxic green)

palette.guidance: Near-black green/blue/purple base, desaturated bone and grey-green mids, ONE violent accent (arterial red or sickly yellow-green). Highlights are small and cold.

geometry: Angular, jagged edges; asymmetry; extreme aspect proportions; branches/claws as thin tapering forms; irregular silhouettes; slightly tilted horizons.
stroke: Sparse: thin, uneven scratchy lines for detail; heavy black masses for shadow; jagged joins (miter) on claw-like shapes.
texture: Grain, scratches, fog gradients, ink bleed; optionally a single displacement to roughen edges.
composition: Off-centre focal point at the edge of the light; large negative darkness pressing in; low or Dutch angle; fog cutting mid-ground; something that half-hides in the dark.
typography: Distressed condensed serif or scratchy hand-lettered look if used; small; low contrast against darkness.
lighting_depth: Hard under-lighting or backlight; hard cast shadows; radial vignette; fog planes reduce contrast with depth.
svg_techniques: start from a near-black base, add light as radialGradient cones/rects with low opacity, then draw only what the light touches
fog: horizontal linearGradient bands with opacity .1-.4 at multiple depths
roughened silhouettes: irregular hand-placed polygon points or one small feTurbulence displacement (scale <= 4) on the silhouette group
vignette overlay as last layer

name: Retro Futurism
description: Yesterday's tomorrow: atomic-age optimism (googie shapes, rockets, starbursts) or 80s synthwave (sunset grids, chrome type, palm silhouettes) rendered with bold flat shapes, gradients and confident geometry.
visual_characteristics: streamlined forms, fins, boomerangs, orbital rings, starbursts
sunset gradients (yellow -> orange -> magenta -> purple) with a striped setting sun
perspective grid floor, chrome lettering, neon line accents
optimistic, clean, poster-like composition

palette.guidance: Two options: (a) atomic age - teal, cream, mustard, tomato red, navy on aged white; (b) synthwave - deep purple/indigo base with hot pink, orange, cyan, yellow sun gradient. Pick one and stay consistent.

geometry: Smooth streamlined curves, perfect circles and ellipses, angular fins, orbits; horizon grid with converging lines; striped sun (horizontal cut bands widening downward).
stroke: Clean monoline 2-4 units with round caps for atomic motifs; neon strokes for grid lines; occasional double line.
texture: Subtle grain or halftone; chrome banding through gradient stops; starfield dots.
composition: Symmetric or centred hero (rocket/sun/car) on a horizon; grid floor to a vanishing point; big title in chrome letters; balanced geometry with plenty of air.
typography: Italic extended or chrome-gradient display type; atomic-age script for retro accents; keep short.
lighting_depth: Sun glow through radialGradient; chrome reflection via multi-stop gradient with a hard horizon band; grid lines fade with distance (opacity gradient).
svg_techniques: striped sun: circle filled with a vertical gradient, masked by horizontal bars that grow thicker toward the bottom
perspective grid: converging lines from a vanishing point + horizontal lines spaced by geometric progression; opacity fade via mask gradient
chrome text: gradient with hard mid-stop; outline stroke + offset shadow
atomic motifs: reusable starburst <symbol> and orbit ellipses with rotation
